resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (DFT/DFPT code)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave pseudopotential code capable of structure relaxation, phonon, and electron-phonon coupling calculations.

resources.notes: Used as the open-source DFT engine replacing the proprietary VASP. Required for all relaxation, phonon, and EPC steps.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials for Pt and H (ultrasoft, GGA-PBE or PW91)

access.notes: SSSP library or standard Quantum ESPRESSO pseudopotential database. Choose GGA-PBE or PW91 ultrasoft pseudopotentials.

resources.notes: Required for all DFT calculations. The exact functional (PBE vs PW91) will shift absolute values; hidden tolerances account for this.

resources.name: Python XRD simulation package (pymatgen or diffpy)

access.notes: Installable from PyPI. Not strictly required—any standard crystallographic tool works—but recommended for simplicity.

resources.notes: Used only for simulating the powder XRD pattern from the relaxed structure. The REFLEX software mentioned in the paper is not required.
